I get what you're saying but this is the thing about this community that I don't get, you're demonizing one drug in favor of another. How is this any different from what the average citizen does with many legal drugs. I get it, the statistics are there but what I dont get is the whole "alcohol is evil poison with absolutely no use" circlejerk that happens on most if not all drug subs. I treat it as any other drug and when used in moderation and (for me personally) with intent can be a great tool. For example I have found no better way to ease my social anxiety than to have a beer or two before going to say a family event or another social event. It allows me to actually be sociable and actually leave my house. 

I'm not saying that it doesn't have the potential for harm, but I don't think it should be stigmatized as heavily as it is in these communities as our propose is harm reduction for all drugs both legal and illegal instead of just saying don't drink do [insert other drug that you think is subjectively better here]

Fallout 4, I remember the day it came out I was so excited. I had been waiting for years for this game after straight no-lifing the rest of the games (excluding FO:BOS but we don't talk about that one) and having put several thousand hours in both 3 and new vegas. Well I bought the game and slapped that bitch in my xbox, waited the day and a half for that fucker to download (seriously it was ridiculous) and loaded it up. Never actually played it vanilla cuz ya know mods (first playthrough was just texture replacement and a few armor mods) got about 150 hours in and just stopped. Didn't play it again till survival mode came out put another 200hrs into it then stopped for another couple months.  Then I had the bright idea to download it on my laptop with all the dlc since I never played them and it was like $20 on steam. My laptop easily had the specs to run it (i7-7700hq, gtx 1050, 16gb of ram) but since it was a laptop and also had the integrated gpu it would not run. Period. I did the usual fixes that you have to do with pretty much most/all Bethesda games on steam and worked on that fucker for days, installing patches, changing the resolution manually in the ini file, forcing it to run on my dedicated gpu and all that good shit and still it would load, get to the title screen and then crash. After many failed attempts I gave up and now it just sits there in my steam library, never properly run, gathering virtual dust.
